scope: Why the Step 9 automatic authored-joint result leaves one 87,188-cell body. Diagnosis only; the size goal is not met and the evidence says it is not reachable by tuning the static solver.

environment.note: No Vulkan device. No live GPU validation performed or claimed.

largest_body_anatomy.reading: One legitimate static assembly. Its interior joints are not overloaded while it stands.

minimum_cut.note: The 486 wood/glass faces are zero-capacity glazing, free for the cut to pass through.

hypotheses.name: authored interface representation incomplete
hypotheses.evidence: 0 cross-part faces inside the large body are unrepresented as authored joints.

hypotheses.name: monolithic concrete foundation hides spatial support
hypotheses.evidence: Foundation decomposed into bays of 128/64/32/24/16 cells giving 1/3/9/16/29 anchored parts. Cut identical in every case: 54 pairs, 1048 bonds, 0 rigid. Concrete internal interfaces are not authored joints, so the slab keeps full capacity and still distributes load.

hypotheses.name: one generation is not enough
hypotheses.evidence: Re-solve of the attached remainder returns Satisfied. Bounded per-generation failure stalls after generation 1 and detaches nothing.
hypotheses.why: A partial cut neither separates the body topologically nor leaves live authored bonds in the next minimum cut: a dead interface has zero capacity, so the cut degenerates onto the already-dead set.

hypotheses.name: per-interface sole-load-path overload test
hypotheses.evidence: 0 overloaded interfaces on both the intact and the half-foundation house. The part graph is too redundant for any single joint to be a sole load path; the shortfall is collective, which is what minimum cut already measures.

hypotheses.name: static self-weight cannot express multi-surface failure
hypotheses.evidence: Minimum cut yields exactly one bipartition per solve. Interior joints of a standing assembly are carrying their load successfully. collapse.rs doctrine forbids loading detached geometry, and correctly: a free-falling body has no internal gravity stress.

fix_applied.name: fracture-aware assembly capacity
fix_applied.change: build() now takes the FractureState; a face whose bond has zero integrity contributes no capacity and is not a failure candidate.
fix_applied.why: The solver credited dead joints with full capacity, so a damaged house read sounder than it is, and a second generation re-nominated spent bonds and could never advance.

next_architectures_not_implemented: Impact-driven interior failure through the existing contact path. The explicit-release live run produced 3425 contact-broken bonds and 113 contact-created fragments; the Step 9 live run recorded zero contact jobs because the detached assembly rested instead of falling. Needs a live run.

A bounded construction-level bending/torque approximation for a detached assembly, loading interior joints from its own span and support footprint. New physics; must not ship without interpretable measurements.
